segment.description: Who receives the campaign (segment DSL version 1). The conditions combine with match: "all" (AND) or "any" (OR). No conditions means every customer.

condition.description: One test of a customer. Each type takes only its own parameters: country, city, language: in (country codes, city names or language codes, from the reference data); signed_up: within_days; basket and purchased: within_days and categories, both optional; order_count: min and/or max number of orders, within_days optional; total_spent: min and/or max in kuruş (100 kuruş = 1 TRY), within_days optional; group: match and conditions, nested at most 3 levels deep. negate excludes the customers the condition matches. Only completed orders count. At most 20 conditions in a segment.

content.description: The message for each channel the campaign uses; leave a channel out to not use it. Texts may use the placeholders {{first_name}}, {{last_name}} and {{city}}, and no others.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Create a campaign draft. It is saved only when complete and valid; otherwise the result lists its problems by field path, to fix and try again. Returns the saved campaign.

name.description: The campaign's name, at most 100 characters.

tools.name: update_campaign
tools.description: Change a draft campaign. Each field given replaces the current one whole (name, segment or content); fields left out stay as they are. Only drafts can change. Returns the saved campaign, or its problems.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: Get a campaign: its status, times, segment and messages, and, once dispatched, its delivery counts by status and channel.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List every campaign, newest first: id, name, status, channels and when it last changed. Use it to find a campaign the user names.

tools.name: estimate_audience
tools.description: Count the customers a segment matches, and how many can be reached by email, by SMS and by either (they have the contact detail and gave permission). Give either a segment or the id of a campaign, not both. Returns counts only.

tools.name: dispatch_campaign
tools.description: Ask the user to approve sending a draft campaign, now or at scheduled_at. This sends nothing: the app shows the user a card with the campaign, its reach and time, to approve or cancel. Only that approval sends the campaign.

scheduled_at.description: RFC 3339 time with an offset, in the future and at most a year ahead. Leave out to send right after approval.
